erp.bc_new_document_v1(uuid,text,timesta.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.bc_new_document_v1(p_request uuid, p_action text, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_payload jsonb, p_policies jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into erp.bc_documents_v1(id,document_number,action,physical_at,responsible,reference,reason,payload,policy_versions,created_by)
  values(p_request,'BCA-'||upper(substr(replace(p_request::text,'-',''),1,16)),p_action,p_at,erp.bc_text_v1(p_payload,'responsible',false,120),
    erp.bc_text_v1(p_payload,'reference',false,200),erp.bc_text_v1(p_payload,'reason',true,1000),p_payload,p_policies,erp.current_app_user_id());
  return p_request;
end;$function$

erp.be_allocation_extra_v1(uuid).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.be_allocation_extra_v1(p_allocation uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select a.conversion_cost_allocated+erp.be_conversion_extra_v1(a.conversion_id)
 from erp.product_conversion_allocations a where a.id=p_allocation
$function$

erp.be_conversion_extra_v1(uuid).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.be_conversion_extra_v1(p_conversion uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(sum(e.target_amount-e.previous_amount),0) from erp.be_conversion_cost_sources_v1 s
 join erp.be_conversion_cost_events_v1 e on e.document_id=s.document_id where s.conversion_id=p_conversion
$function$

erp.be_nonpo_admitted_v1(uuid).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.be_nonpo_admitted_v1(p_conversion uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from erp.be_conversion_sources_v1 b join erp.product_conversions c on c.id=b.conversion_id
  join erp.fg_lots l on l.id=b.source_lot_id join erp.v_current_hpp h on h.lot_id=l.id
  where b.conversion_id=p_conversion and l.po_id is null and l.product_id=c.from_product_id
   and l.lot_origin<>'VOIDED_PRODUCTION' and h.hpp_per_pcs>=0)
$function$
